question: My Emirates ID expired two months ago. What late fee will I pay, and does ICP ever waive it?
document_fact_needed: Renewal more than one month after expiry costs AED 20 a day, up to AED 1,000.
data_fact_needed: Exemption from Late Fees: 43,258 transactions in 2023 and 25,229 in 2025, so waivers exist and are granted at scale.

question: How early can I renew my Emirates ID, and how busy is ICP with renewals?
document_fact_needed: The card can be renewed up to six months before it expires, through ICP centres, the website or an accredited typing centre.
data_fact_needed: Renewal of ID Card: 1,800,115 in 2020 rising to 5,856,085 in 2025.

question: My residence visa is about to expire. What happens if I overstay, and how many residence permits does ICP renew each year?
document_fact_needed: The sponsor must renew before expiry; grace periods reach up to six months by category; overstay costs AED 50 a day.
data_fact_needed: Renewal of Residence Permits: 3,513,863 in 2023 and 3,763,072 in 2025.

question: Do I have to go to a typing centre for my residency medical test, or can I apply online? What do most people do?
document_fact_needed: Applicants aged 18 and over must pass a medical fitness test for a residence visa; the page links the EHS medical fitness service.
data_fact_needed: EHS website share rose from 14.5% of exams in 2022 to 57.1% in 2025 (813,374 of 1,424,313). EHS coverage only.

question: My employer in Dubai has not paid me. How do I file a labour complaint, and does MOHRE actually resolve many?
document_fact_needed: Complaints go through the MOHRE website, app or phone; if no amicable settlement within 14 days, MOHRE refers the dispute to court.
data_fact_needed: City_En = Dubai: 103,844 solved complaints in 2019, up from 21,314 in 2009.

question: If MOHRE cannot settle my complaint, how long do I have to take it to court, and are complaints from workers in elementary jobs in Sharjah common?
document_fact_needed: A worker whose complaint is referred must register it with the competent court within 14 days of the referral.
